name: voc-hub-autoresolve
description: Autonomous VoC Hub closing agent for a self-assigned Jira backlog, maintained by panicdna.

plugins.name: voc-hub-autoresolve
plugins.description: Finds the oldest unresolved VoC whose Jira ticket was assigned to the configured operator, drafts a reply from the customer's message, sends it, and marks the VoC resolved — one VoC per run, no per-run approval.
